criteria.loadScope: Sequential batches in one process; not concurrent load, throughput or a statistical benchmark.
criteria.inputRule: Reset public LCG seed for each workload; state=(imul(state,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0; value=String(state%15-7). Eight entries per vector; convolution has two vectors.
criteria.costRule: Retain every actual construction, rejected candidate, selected qualification, dependency/scope check, current admission, productive arithmetic, independent reference arithmetic and comparison. Scenario attribution reuses the same ancestor charge; do not sum alternative scenario totals. Actual campaign totals deduplicate charge identities, not repeated execution.
criteria.specialistPreparation: Zero additional arithmetic preparation exposed by this fixed implementation. Supplied authorship, proof, parsing and institutional qualification costs are unknown, not zero.
criteria.breakEven: For identical checked task families, B=complete counted build, V=current complete admission, W(R)=checked execution. Retained=B+V+W(R); rebuilding=R*(B+V)+W(R). Difference=(R-1)*(B+V); R=1 ties. Unknown costs are excluded; this is not monetary break-even.
criteria: Every base task output in all three arms equals the independently implemented exact specification; retain every failure.

Every construction and admission is actually executed; full observed ledgers, including search failures and direct/inherited controls, remain in evidence. Never substitute selected-path cost for campaign cost.
All nine alternative scenario costs and budget fits are reported, including losses and ties. No required economic advantage or budget fit.

Changed kernel: independently qualified direct/inherited constructions agree in artifact identity; stale inverse fails the new residual; successor passes. Singular kernel is rejected and its spent work retained. Ancestors remain charged.
Observed rebuilding-minus-retention equals the predeclared formula for each workload. Specialist comparison counts its exposed preparation and keeps unknown preparation explicit.

Existing source-bound controller reaches SUCCESSOR_ACCEPTED_LOCAL, writes a completed workspace, reads and validates it, and retains identical canonical bytes and final state. No external approval, physical qualification, payment or thermal acceptance is inferred.
